items.name: astryx-base
items.title: XO UI base
items.description: Installs XO UI core + the neutral theme packages. Run astryx-nextjs once to set up the CSS and Theme provider.

items.name: astryx-nextjs
items.title: XO UI setup for Next.js
items.description: One-time setup for Next.js + Tailwind v4: replaces app/globals.css with the XO UI layer order and adds the Theme provider.
items.docs: Last step: in app/layout.tsx, import { AstryxProviders } from "@/components/astryx-providers" and wrap {children} in <AstryxProviders>.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action on click. Primary, secondary, ghost and destructive variants with sizes, icons, loading and async click states. Built on XO UI Button.

items.name: metric-strip
items.title: Metric strip
items.description: A row of headline metrics with trend tokens, separated by vertical dividers. Built with XO UI.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: AlertDialog asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before it happens. Use it for things like deleting content, revoking access, or discarding unsaved changes.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: AppShell is the page shell for an application. It provides slots for top navigation, side navigation, banners, and main content.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Maintains a fixed width-to-height ratio for its children as its container resizes. Use it for media containers like videos, images, thumbnails, or any content that needs consistent proportions.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar represents a person or team with a profile photo, initials, or a default icon. Use it in comment headers, contact lists, chat messages, user cards, and anywhere you need to identify someone visually.

items.name: avatar-group
items.title: Avatar Group
items.description: AvatarGroup displays multiple avatars in an overlapping row with an optional overflow indicator. Uses a compositional API: pass Avatar children directly so each avatar can carry its own props (status dots, click handlers, etc.).

items.name: avatar-group-overflow
items.title: Avatar Group Overflow
items.description: AvatarGroupOverflow appears at the end of an AvatarGroup to summarize people who are not shown individually. Use it when a group is sliced to a small number of visible avatars but the hidden count still matters.

items.name: avatar-status-dot
items.title: Avatar Status Dot
items.description: Used inside Avatar. Size-aware status indicator dot that reads avatar size from context and scales proportionally. Each variant pairs a colour with a distinct built-in shape (filled, ring, minus) so status is never conveyed by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge highlights a status or category at a glance. Use it sparingly: only when a value represents a distinct state (Active, Failed) or a grouping tag (Engineering, Design).

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Banner shows a persistent message at the top of a page or section. Use it for form errors, system updates, maintenance notices, or success confirmations that the user needs to see until they act on it.

items.name: base-typeahead
items.title: Base Typeahead
items.description: Used inside Typeahead. Composable combobox engine providing a bare input, search, keyboard navigation, and a styled result dropdown. It renders no input wrapper, border, or selected-value token.

items.name: blockquote
items.title: Blockquote
items.description: A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color. Use to highlight quoted content, testimonials, or excerpts.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: A mobile touch surface for filters, actions, forms, and detail views that should rise from the bottom of the viewport; use BottomSheetSwitcher for multi-step flows.

items.name: bottom-sheet-switcher
items.title: Bottom Sheet Switcher
items.description: Coordinates a multi-step bottom-sheet flow in one shared dialog; set activeSheet to a nested BottomSheet's sheetId to open or switch steps, and to null to close.

items.name: breadcrumb-item
items.title: Breadcrumb Item
items.description: BreadcrumbItem represents one destination, action, current location, or sibling-menu trigger inside a Breadcrumbs trail.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Breadcrumbs show a trail of links from the root to the current page. Use them at the top of detail pages, settings panels, or anywhere the user needs to see where they are and navigate back up.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: ButtonGroup joins related actions into a single connected control. Use it when multiple buttons represent related choices or operations that belong together visually, like copy/cut/paste, or undo/redo.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid. Use it in booking flows, scheduling UIs, date filters, or anywhere the user needs to see surrounding dates for context.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card is a bordered, elevated container for discrete, self-contained items: things you could reorder, remove, or interact with independently. Cards are NOT the default layout tool.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Carousel scrolls a row of items horizontally when they overflow the available width. Use it for card grids, image galleries, product lists, or any set of items that should be browsable without taking up the full page.

items.name: center
items.title: Center
items.description: Center aligns content to the middle of its container. Use it for empty states, loading screens, login forms, or any content that should sit in the center of the available space.

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: ChatComposer is the message-entry shell for a chat surface. It coordinates a controlled or uncontrolled draft, provides a default token-capable input and send/stop action, and arranges optional drawer, header, footer, and status content.

items.name: chat-composer-drawer
items.title: Chat Composer Drawer
items.description: Use ChatComposerDrawer in the ChatComposer drawer slot for supplementary content such as attachments, context chips, or previews. Provide count only when people should be able to collapse that content.

items.name: chat-composer-input
items.title: Chat Composer Input
items.description: Pass ChatComposerInput to ChatComposer's input slot when the draft needs trigger menus, inline tokens, history recall, dictation insertion, or file intake.

items.name: chat-dictation-button
items.title: Chat Dictation Button
items.description: ChatDictationButton is a toggle button that starts and stops voice dictation inside a chat composer. It pairs with useChatDictation to show a microphone icon when idle and animated frequency bars when listening.

items.name: chat-layout
items.title: Chat Layout
items.description: ChatLayout is the layout shell for full-page chat interfaces. It renders messages in normal page flow and docks the composer to the bottom with a frosted glass blur layer.

items.name: chat-layout-scroll-button
items.title: Chat Layout Scroll Button
items.description: Used inside Chat. Floating scroll-to-bottom button that appears when the user scrolls away from the latest messages. It fades in as a compact icon button and expands to show a label when new messages arrive.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: Used inside Chat. Sender context wrapper: handles avatar, name, metadata, and alignment based on sender role.

items.name: chat-message-bubble
items.title: Chat Message Bubble
items.description: Styled content container for the chat "bubble." Reads sender from parent ChatMessage context to auto-style the background. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visible boundary.

items.name: chat-message-list
items.title: Chat Message List
items.description: Used inside Chat. Presentational message container with density context and infinite scroll support. Provides role="log" with aria-live="polite" for accessibility.

items.name: chat-message-metadata
items.title: Chat Message Metadata
items.description: Place ChatMessageMetadata below a message or in the last ChatMessageBubble metadata slot to show a timestamp, footer content, and optional delivery status. Non-rendering scalar slots (booleans and empty strings) create no separator; numeric zero remains visible.

items.name: chat-send-button
items.title: Chat Send Button
items.description: Use ChatSendButton as ChatComposer’s send control when the action should switch between sending and stopping. Inside ChatComposer it reads readiness, streaming state, and action callbacks from context; standalone usage supplies those values explicitly.

items.name: chat-system-message
items.title: Chat System Message
items.description: Use ChatSystemMessage for concise, non-sender content inside a chat transcript. Choose the default variant for factual status notices and the divider variant for date or section breaks.

items.name: chat-tokenized-text
items.title: Chat Tokenized Text
items.description: Use ChatTokenizedText inside a chat message when stored plain text contains serialized token values that should be projected as inline badges or caller-rendered token content. Unmatched text is preserved exactly and empty token values are ignored so rendering always finishes.

items.name: chat-tool-calls
items.title: Chat Tool Calls
items.description: ChatToolCalls displays tool or function call invocations from an LLM response. Pass an array of calls and the component handles the rest: a single call renders inline, while multiple calls collapse into a summary with the latest call visible at the surface.

items.name: checkbox-input
items.title: Checkbox Input
items.description: CheckboxInput toggles a single on/off value. Use it for settings like "Enable notifications", terms acceptance, or opt-in choices.

items.name: checkbox-list
items.title: Checkbox List
items.description: CheckboxList shows a small group of checkboxes so users can turn several options on or off at once. Place it in settings pages, filter panels, or forms where every choice should be visible without scrolling.

items.name: checkbox-list-item
items.title: Checkbox List Item
items.description: Individual checkbox item with label, description, and end content slot. Works in collection mode (inside a CheckboxList with a value array) or standalone mode (inside List, or inside a CheckboxList without value, such as a select-all item).

items.name: citation
items.title: Citation
items.description: Citations display inline references to external sources. Use them to attribute information within AI-generated responses, articles, or anywhere provenance and source links are needed.

items.name: clickable-card
items.title: Clickable Card
items.description: An interactive card for navigation or action targets. Nested interactive elements work independently.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: CodeBlock renders syntax-highlighted code with line numbers, a copy button, and optional collapsible sections. Use CodeBlock for multi-line snippets like source files, terminal commands, and configuration examples.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Collapsible hides and reveals content behind a trigger button. Use it in settings panels, FAQ pages, or detail views to keep the page scannable while letting users drill into sections they care about.

items.name: collapsible-group
items.title: Collapsible Group
items.description: Coordinates multiple Collapsible instances so only one (single mode) or any number (multiple mode) can be open at a time. Renders no wrapper DOM element unless dividers are enabled.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: CommandPalette is a searchable dialog for quick access to commands, navigation, and actions. Use it as a keyboard-driven launcher powered by SearchSource for filtering and selection.

items.name: command-palette-empty
items.title: Command Palette Empty
items.description: Empty state display for the results area. Rendered automatically by CommandPalette for no-results and no-query states.

items.name: command-palette-footer
items.title: Command Palette Footer
items.description: Used inside Command Palette. Footer showing keyboard navigation hints. Renders default arrow/Enter/Escape hints when no children are provided.

items.name: command-palette-group
items.title: Command Palette Group
items.description: Visual grouping with a heading label. Place inside CommandPaletteList.

items.name: command-palette-input
items.title: Command Palette Input
items.description: Used inside Command Palette. Search input slot. Auto-focuses on mount.

items.name: command-palette-item
items.title: Command Palette Item
items.description: Used inside Command Palette. A selectable item. Accepts arbitrary children for full rendering control.

items.name: command-palette-list
items.title: Command Palette List
items.description: Scrollable results container. Renders as a listbox for ARIA. Contains CommandPaletteItem and CommandPaletteGroup children.

items.name: complex-selector
items.title: Complex Selector
items.description: Use ComplexSelector when a selection needs richer custom content than a Selector option row. It is intentionally one component: ComplexSelector owns the field, trigger, popover, focus restore, and changeAction flow, while the content render prop owns the selector-specific accessible structure.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click context menu that appears at the cursor position. Use to provide contextual actions for specific elements or regions without cluttering the UI with visible buttons.

items.name: date-input
items.title: Date Input
items.description: DateInput lets the user type or pick a date from a calendar popover. Use it for scheduling, deadlines, booking dates, or any form field that needs a specific calendar date.

items.name: date-range-input
items.title: Date Range Input
items.description: DateRangeInput lets users select a start and end date from a dual-month calendar popover. Use it for filtering data by time period, report generation, analytics dashboards, and booking flows.

items.name: date-time-input
items.title: Date Time Input
items.description: DateTimeInput combines date and time selection in one field. With presentation="adaptive-native" (the default), mouse/trackpad devices use XO UI typed fields and popovers, while coarse-pointer devices use browser/OS date and time controls in the same two-segment field. presentation="native" uses both native controls on every pointer; presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet" keeps XO UI's own surfaces — pointer fields on fine pointers and the coordinated Date/Time bottom sheet on coarse pointers; "popover" and "bottom-sheet" force one XO UI surface on every pointer.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog displays a modal overlay that blocks interaction with the page until the user responds. Use it for delete confirmations, edit forms, terms acceptance, or any decision that should not be skipped.

items.name: dialog-header
items.title: Dialog Header
items.description: Use DialogHeader to give a dialog a labelled title area and optional close control.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A visual separator that divides content into distinct sections. Use to create clear boundaries between groups of related content, or to demarcate interactive regions within a layout.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A dropdown menu that displays a list of actionable items in a popup triggered by a button. Use to present action options as a next step in a process, or to offer contextual actions without cluttering the interface.

items.name: dropdown-menu-checkbox-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Checkbox Item
items.description: A checkable menu item (role="menuitemcheckbox") that toggles an independent boolean. Use for on/off options inside a DropdownMenu; for a one-of-N choice use DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

items.name: dropdown-menu-divider
items.title: Dropdown Menu Divider
items.description: Used inside Dropdown Menu. A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu. Renders role="separator", so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order.

items.name: dropdown-menu-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Item
items.description: Used inside Dropdown Menu. Helper component for custom item rendering with consistent styling.

items.name: dropdown-menu-radio-group
items.title: Dropdown Menu Radio Group
items.description: Used inside Dropdown Menu. A single-select group of radio menu items (role="group" of menuitemradio). Owns the selected value and lays its items out with the menu's inter-item gap.

items.name: dropdown-menu-radio-item
items.title: Dropdown Menu Radio Item
items.description: A single option in a DropdownMenuRadioGroup (role="menuitemradio"). Must be used inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup.

items.name: dropdown-menu-sub-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu Submenu
items.description: A single menu row that reveals a nested flyout of its own items. The row adopts DropdownMenuItem semantics (label / icon / description / isDisabled); its children become the flyout content.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: EmptyState shows a placeholder when a content area has no data. Use it for empty lists, zero search results, first-time setups, or cleared inboxes.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Field is a low-level wrapper for custom, native, or third-party controls that do not already provide field label, description, and status UI. Use it when you need the Field shell around a control you own; use styled XO UI inputs like TextInput, Typeahead, and Select directly when they already expose label, description, and validation props.

items.name: field-label
items.title: Field Label
items.description: Used inside Field. Standalone label component with optional/required indicators and tooltip support.

items.name: field-status
items.title: Field Status
items.description: FieldStatus renders validation feedback for fields and field-like controls. Use it directly for custom controls that need the same error, warning, or success presentation as Field.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File Input
items.description: FileInput provides file upload with optional drag-and-drop support. Use it for single or multiple file selection with built-in validation for file type, size, and count.

items.name: form-layout
items.title: Form Layout
items.description: A layout container that arranges form fields with consistent spacing and direction. FormLayout handles where fields go, not state or submission.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: A CSS grid layout container for arranging children in rows and columns. Use Grid for card galleries, dashboards, and any multi-column layout.

items.name: grid-span
items.title: Grid Span
items.description: Grid item that spans multiple columns or rows.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: HoverCard shows additional information when the user hovers or focuses a trigger element. Use it for profile cards, link summaries, or inline definitions where the user needs more context without navigating away.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Icons are small visual symbols that represent actions, objects, or concepts. They improve scannability and reinforce meaning alongside text.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text. Use IconButton in toolbars, table rows, and compact UI where space is tight and the icon is universally understood.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: InputGroup connects an input with prefix/suffix addons in a single visual unit. Use it for URL fields, currency inputs, search fields with action buttons, or any input that needs contextual decorations.

items.name: input-group-text
items.title: Input Group Text
items.description: A prefix or suffix text element rendered inside InputGroup. Displays text or icons.

items.name: internationalization-provider
items.title: Internationalization Provider
items.description: Used inside i18n. Wraps your app to set the active locale and (optionally) merge additional translation catalogs + per-locale overrides. XO UI components inside the subtree resolve their strings against this context.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A single, flexible item primitive that unifies the "start content + label + description + end content" pattern across XO UI. Use it wherever you need a structured row: dropdown menus, selectors, contact lists, notifications, file browsers, and activity feeds.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Renders a keyboard shortcut as styled key badges. Use Kbd in tooltips, menus, and help text to show key combinations.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout
items.description: Layout is a general five-slot primitive for arranging header, start, content, end, and footer regions within a page or bounded container. AppShell owns the page shell and app-wide navigation behavior; use HStack or VStack for simple directional stacking.

items.name: layout-content
items.title: Layout Content
items.description: Used inside Layout. Scrollable main content area.

items.name: layout-footer
items.title: Layout Footer
items.description: Used inside Layout. Bottom bar for action bars, pagination, and status bars.

items.name: layout-header
items.title: Layout Header
items.description: Used inside Layout. Top bar for page titles, app bars, and toolbars.

items.name: layout-panel
items.title: Layout Panel
items.description: Used inside Layout. Sidebar for navigation, settings, or inspector panels.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A fullscreen overlay for viewing images and videos at full resolution. Supports single-item and gallery modes with prev/next navigation, optional zoom and pan for images, and native video controls.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A styled anchor for inline and standalone text navigation. Supports external links, underline variants, tooltips, and custom link components for router integration.

items.name: link-provider
items.title: Link Provider
items.description: Wraps your app to replace the default <a> tag with a framework-specific link component (e.g. Next.js Link) for client-side routing across all XO UI components.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A vertical collection of items with consistent spacing, dividers, and optional markers. Supports headers, icons, avatars, badges, and interactive items with click or link behavior.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: List item with label, description, start/end content slots, and interactive patterns.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Renders a markdown string as XO UI-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.

items.name: media-theme
items.title: Media Theme
items.description: Used inside theme. Provides token overrides for content rendered on inverted surfaces: media overlays, scrims, toasts, and tooltips. The base behavior flips color-scheme so all light-dark() tokens resolve to the correct side.

items.name: metadata-list
items.title: Metadata List
items.description: MetadataList displays key-value pairs for object attributes like quality, condition, and status, in a structured layout. Use it for detail panels, settings summaries, and record information.

items.name: metadata-list-item
items.title: Metadata List Item
items.description: A single labeled metadata value within an MetadataList.

items.name: mobile-nav
items.title: Mobile Nav
items.description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation. MobileNav is the mobile counterpart to SideNav and accepts the same children.

items.name: more-menu
items.title: More Menu
items.description: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions. Use it for secondary actions that don't need to be always visible, like in table rows, card headers, or toolbars.

items.name: multi-selector
items.title: Multi Selector
items.description: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list. Selected items can display as a count, labels, or badges.

items.name: nav-icon
items.title: Nav Icon
items.description: NavIcon is a circular icon container with an accent-colored background. Use it in navigation headers such as TopNavHeading and PageNavHeader to visually identify a section or application.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: A form input for numeric values with built-in validation, min/max constraints, and step controls. Use NumberInput for quantities, measurements, percentages, and similar inputs.

items.name: outline
items.title: Outline
items.description: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages. Use it for navigation within a single page, not for app routes.

items.name: overflow-list
items.title: Overflow List
items.description: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width. Use OverflowList for breadcrumbs, toolbars, tag lists, or any row that needs to collapse gracefully at smaller sizes.

items.name: overlay
items.title: Overlay
items.description: Overlay layers action or supporting content over media, cards, video, or other bounded surfaces with an optional scrim and reveal behavior.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Pagination lets users step through pages of content. Place it below a table, list, or card grid so users can move forward and backward through results.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element. Use it for secondary actions, inline confirmations, or supplementary information that does not warrant a full dialog.

items.name: power-search
items.title: Power Search
items.description: PowerSearch is a structured filter bar where each token represents a field, operator, and value. Use it for complex multi-dimensional filtering when users need to combine multiple search criteria.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated.

items.name: radio-list
items.title: Radio List
items.description: A group of options where only one can be selected at a time. All options are visible at once, making it easy to compare choices.

items.name: radio-list-item
items.title: Radio List Item
items.description: Used inside Radio List. Individual radio item with label, description, and content slots.

items.name: scrollable-area
items.title: Scrollable Area
items.description: Provides a native scroll viewport and a real observed content box. The viewport enters the tab order only while a requested logical axis is effectively scrollable, and containment applies only to effective axes.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: Section is the correct way to create page regions and group related content on a page. Use it for settings groups, form sections, sidebar areas, or any time you need visual separation between parts of a page.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A segmented button group that allows users to make a single selection from a small set of mutually exclusive options. Use SegmentedControl when all options should be visible at once and the selection controls a value or mode, not page navigation.

items.name: segmented-control-item
items.title: Segmented Control Item
items.description: Used inside Segmented Control. Individual segment item rendering as a radio button within the segmented control.

items.name: selectable-card
items.title: Selectable Card
items.description: A card that toggles between selected and unselected states with an accent border. For navigation use ClickableCard.

items.name: selector
items.title: Selector
items.description: A dropdown selector for choosing a single value from a list of options. Supports labels, validation, descriptions, and required/optional states.

items.name: selector-option
items.title: Selector Option
items.description: Helper component for custom item rendering inside an Selector renderOption prop.

items.name: side-nav
items.title: Side Nav
items.description: A sidebar navigation component for organizing application pages with sections, nested items, and icons. Use SideNav as the primary navigation when an app has 5 or more destinations or requires hierarchical grouping.

items.name: side-nav-collapse-button
items.title: Side Nav Collapse Button
items.description: Toggle button for sidenav collapse. Place inside SideNav (reads context automatically) or outside it (hand the same controlled collapsible config to both).

items.name: side-nav-heading
items.title: Side Nav Heading
items.description: Used inside Side Nav. Product/suite/account heading with smart interaction boundary logic for links and a menu popover.

items.name: side-nav-item
items.title: Side Nav Item
items.description: Used inside Side Nav. Navigation item with icon, selected state, optional end content, and nesting support via children.

items.name: side-nav-section
items.title: Side Nav Section
items.description: Used inside Side Nav. Section grouping with an optional title, subtitle, and end content.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: An animated shimmer placeholder that previews the shape of content while it loads. Use it to build loading screens that match the layout of the real content.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range within defined bounds. Supports single value and range selection, tick marks, custom value formatting, and vertical orientation.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An animated loading indicator for processes with unknown duration, such as data fetching or form submission. Supports visible labels, multiple sizes, and a dark background variant.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: Stack arranges items in a row or column with consistent spacing. Use the gap prop to control the space between items.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status Dot
items.description: A small colored dot that communicates status like online/offline presence or severity levels. Supports five semantic variants and an optional pulse animation.

items.name: step
items.title: Step
items.description: Individual step within a Stepper. Renders a progress-bar segment, an indicator, and a label with optional description.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Steppers display progress through a sequence of logical and numbered steps. Use them for multi-step workflows like forms, onboarding flows, or checkout processes where users need to see their position and the steps ahead.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle control for on/off states that take effect immediately. Supports labels, descriptions, loading states, and validation.

items.name: tab
items.title: Tab
items.description: Used inside Tab List. Individual tab item that renders as a button or an anchor link, with selected-state styling and optional icons.

items.name: tab-list
items.title: Tab List
items.description: TabList provides tab-style navigation for organizing content into categorized sections. Use it to let users switch between related views without leaving the page, with overflow items handled by a built-in "more" menu.

items.name: tab-menu
items.title: Tab Menu
items.description: Used inside Tab List. Overflow menu trigger that opens a dropdown of additional tab options, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table displays structured data in rows and columns with consistent dimensionality. It supports rich cell content, sorting, selection, pagination, and column management through a composable plugin system.

items.name: table-body
items.title: Table Body
items.description: Used inside Table. <tbody> wrapper for children mode. Holds the data rows.

items.name: table-cell
items.title: Table Cell
items.description: <td> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, font size, and divider borders when used inside Table.

items.name: table-footer
items.title: Table Footer
items.description: Used inside Table. <tfoot> wrapper for children mode. Holds summary or total rows beneath the body.

items.name: table-header
items.title: Table Header
items.description: <thead> wrapper for children mode. Holds the header row, whose cells are TableHeaderCell.

items.name: table-header-cell
items.title: Table Header Cell
items.description: <th> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, semibold weight, secondary text color, and divider borders when used inside Table.

items.name: table-row
items.title: Table Row
items.description: <tr> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply striped, hover, and divider styles when used inside Table.

items.name: table-selection-toolbar
items.title: Table Selection Toolbar
items.description: Pass both outputs of useTableSelectionState to their matching consumers: selectionConfig to useTableSelection and selectionState to TableSelectionToolbar. Render product actions through startContent.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Text renders styled body text and headings from the theme. Use Text with a semantic type for body copy, labels, and captions, and Heading for section titles that output the correct h1–h6 element.

items.name: text-area
items.title: Text Area
items.description: TextArea is a multi-line text input for collecting longer-form content like comments, descriptions, or messages. Use it when the expected input spans multiple lines.

items.name: text-input
items.title: Text Input
items.description: TextInput collects short-form text like names, emails, or search queries. Use it for single-line values where the expected input is brief.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Wraps a subtree with a specific XO UI theme. For static production themes, use astryx theme build and import the generated CSS plus built theme object for first-paint and SSR performance.

items.name: thumbnail
items.title: Thumbnail
items.description: Thumbnail displays a compact, square preview of an image attachment. It shows a shimmer effect while uploading, the image on success, and a placeholder icon when no source is set.

items.name: time-input
items.title: Time Input
items.description: TimeInput uses a browser/OS time picker on coarse pointers by default and XO UI's typed field on fine pointers. It converts values to a standard format and supports arrow-key adjustment on the typed surface.

items.name: timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: Displays a standardized elapsed duration for active work without scheduling a React render on every tick. Elapsed format updates by second below one hour and by minute after one hour; clock format remains second-precise.

items.name: timestamp
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: Timestamp formats a date or time value into human-readable text. Use it to show when something was created, updated, or is scheduled; picking relative for recency, absolute for precision, or auto to let the component decide.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toast shows a brief, non-blocking notification to confirm an action or present temporary information. Use it for scenarios where the user needs feedback but not a decision, such as saving, deleting, or changing a status.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: ToggleButton switches between selected and unselected states to represent a persistent on/off choice. Use it standalone for binary actions like bold, mute, or favorite, or inside a ToggleButtonGroup for single-select or multi-select toolbar controls.

items.name: toggle-button-group
items.title: Toggle Button Group
items.description: Used inside Toggle Button. Groups toggle buttons for exclusive (single) or multi-select behavior. Uses discriminated union on type for type-safe value/onChange.

items.name: token
items.title: Token
items.description: Token is a small, inline element for representing discrete pieces of associated data, like tags, categories, or selections. Use it to label content, show active filters, or represent removable items like selected recipients in a compose field.

items.name: tokenizer
items.title: Tokenizer
items.description: Tokenizer is a multi-select input that lets users search, select, and manage multiple items displayed as removable chips. Use it when users need to build a set of selections from a searchable data source, like adding team members, applying tags, or choosing filters.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: Toolbar is a horizontal bar with left, center, and right areas. Use it for contextual actions within a content area (above a table, inside a card, or in a panel), not as a page-level header.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short text hint that appears on hover or focus, anchored to a trigger element. Use it to describe icon-only buttons, show the full text of truncated labels, or provide supplementary context without cluttering the UI.

items.name: top-nav
items.title: Top Nav
items.description: TopNav is a horizontal navigation bar for product-level navigation in application headers. Use TopNav for 5 or fewer always-visible navigation items, or minimal navigation paired with search and controls.

items.name: top-nav-heading
items.title: Top Nav Heading
items.description: Product/suite/account heading for the TopNav heading slot. Supports smart interaction boundary logic: logo, heading text, superheading/subheading with independent links, and an optional menu popover with automatic chevron indicator.

items.name: top-nav-item
items.title: Top Nav Item
items.description: Navigation link item for use in TopNav startContent: renders as an anchor with hover and selected states.

items.name: top-nav-mega-menu
items.title: Top Nav Mega Menu
items.description: Used inside Top Nav. Navigation item that displays a full-width mega menu panel on hover. Uses a slots API with items and featured props.

items.name: top-nav-mega-menu-featured-card
items.title: Top Nav Mega Menu Featured Card
items.description: Standard featured card for the TopNavMegaMenu featured slot. Provides a consistent card with optional image, title, description, and CTA link.

items.name: top-nav-mega-menu-item
items.title: Top Nav Mega Menu Item
items.description: An individual item inside an TopNavMegaMenu. Renders itself in both desktop (popover grid) and mobile drawer modes via render mode context.

items.name: top-nav-menu
items.title: Top Nav Menu
items.description: Used inside Top Nav. Navigation item that displays a hover-triggered popover menu with rich items containing an icon, title, and optional description.

items.name: tree-list
items.title: Tree List
items.description: An expandable tree structure for displaying hierarchical data with branch connector lines. Use it for file explorers, nested category browsers, or any interface that visualizes parent-child relationships.

items.name: typeahead
items.title: Typeahead
items.description: A searchable input for selecting a single item from a large or dynamic dataset. Results appear as the user types, with support for async data sources, debounced search, and custom item rendering.

items.name: typeahead-item
items.title: Typeahead Item
items.description: Used inside Typeahead. Default dropdown item renderer for typeahead results. Shows label with optional icon, description, and avatar.

items.name: visually-hidden
items.title: VisuallyHidden
items.description: Renders content in the accessibility tree while hiding it visually. Use for accessible names on icon-only controls, aria-live announcement regions, and supplementary screen-reader context.

items.name: block-alert-dialog-async-action
items.title: AlertDialog - Loading
items.description: A confirmation dialog that shows a spinner while the action runs.

items.name: block-alert-dialog-delete-confirmation
items.title: AlertDialog - Delete
items.description: A delete button that asks the user to confirm before deleting.

items.name: block-app-shell-content-only
items.title: AppShell - Content Only
items.description: Minimal shell with no navigation, useful for full-bleed pages, auth screens, or embedded views.

items.name: block-app-shell-mobile-hook-usage
items.title: useAppShellMobile - Custom Mobile Trigger
items.description: Custom mobile navigation trigger built with useAppShellMobile. The trigger consumes the surrounding AppShell context instead of rendering its own shell.

items.name: block-app-shell-showcase
items.title: AppShell
items.description: A basic app shell with content padding.

items.name: block-app-shell-side-nav-only
items.title: AppShell - Side Nav Only
items.description: App shell with SideNav header providing app identity, no TopNav needed.

items.name: block-app-shell-top-nav-only
items.title: AppShell - Top Nav Only
items.description: Simple layout with TopNav and no side navigation, suitable for landing pages.

items.name: block-app-shell-top-nav-with-side-nav
items.title: AppShell - Top Nav with Side Nav
items.description: The most common layout with TopNav for app identity and SideNav for page-level navigation.

items.name: block-app-shell-with-banner
items.title: AppShell - With Banner
items.description: Full layout with TopNav, SideNav, and a dismissable info banner between the nav and content.

items.name: block-aspect-ratio-circle-image
items.title: AspectRatio - Circle Image
items.description: Circular container via shape="ellipse" with ratio={1}, ideal for avatars and profile images.

items.name: block-aspect-ratio-image-gallery
items.title: AspectRatio - Image Gallery
items.description: Grid of images with consistent 4:3 aspect ratios.

items.name: block-aspect-ratio-showcase
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: Three aspect ratio containers at equal height (1:1, 4:3, and 16:9), each showing an image with its ratio labeled below.

items.name: block-aspect-ratio-square-image
items.title: AspectRatio - Square Image
items.description: 1:1 square aspect ratio, ideal for avatars and Instagram-style images.

items.name: block-aspect-ratio-widescreen
items.title: AspectRatio - 16:9 Widescreen Image
items.description: 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio wrapping an image.

items.name: block-aspect-ratio-with-skeleton
items.title: AspectRatio - Loading Skeleton
items.description: Aspect ratio container with a skeleton loading placeholder.

items.name: block-avatar-fallback-chain
items.title: Avatar - Fallback Chain
items.description: Demonstrates the avatar fallback chain: primary image, fallback image, initials, then default icon.

items.name: block-avatar-group
items.title: Avatar - Group
items.description: Overlap multiple avatars in a row to represent a group of people. Use for team lists, PR reviewers, or participant counts where you want to show faces without taking up much space.

items.name: block-avatar-group-interactive
items.title: AvatarGroup - Interactive
items.description: A facepile whose avatars link to profiles, with an overflow indicator that opens the full member list. The whole group is one Tab stop; arrow keys move between the avatars and the overflow button.

items.name: block-avatar-group-overflow-custom-text
items.title: AvatarGroupOverflow - Custom Text
items.description: Provide short custom children such as 12+ when the overflow count needs compact product-specific formatting.

items.name: block-avatar-group-overflow-default
items.title: AvatarGroupOverflow - Default Count
items.description: Use AvatarGroupOverflow without children to render the standard +N overflow count.

items.name: block-avatar-group-overflow-showcase
items.title: AvatarGroupOverflow
items.description: Overflow indicators for hidden avatars, including the default +N label and custom count text.

items.name: block-avatar-group-showcase
items.title: AvatarGroup
items.description: Overlapping avatar rows with a sliced visible set and a server-side overflow count. Shows team members in a compact facepile layout.

items.name: block-avatar-initials-fallback
items.title: Avatar - Initials
items.description: Show initials instead of a photo. The avatar extracts the first and last initials from the name automatically. Use when you only have a user name, like in anonymous accounts or new user onboarding.

items.name: block-avatar-interactive
items.title: Avatar - Interactive
items.description: Make an avatar interactive by passing `href` to render it as a link or `onClick` to render it as a button. Both forms are focusable and show a focus-visible ring for keyboard users. Use for profile links, mention pop-ups, or any avatar people can act on.

items.name: block-avatar-showcase
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatars at every size with an image, initials fallback, and a status dot. A quick visual reference for choosing the right size.

items.name: block-avatar-status-dot-showcase
items.title: AvatarStatusDot
items.description: AvatarStatusDot renders a presence indicator on an Avatar, with variants for positive, neutral, and negative states. The dot size automatically coordinates with the Avatar size.

items.name: block-avatar-status-dot-variants
items.title: AvatarStatusDot - Variants
items.description: Presence dots on Avatars using the success, neutral, and error variants. Pass an AvatarStatusDot to the Avatar status prop; the dot sizes itself to match the Avatar.

items.name: block-avatar-tooltip
items.title: Avatar - Tooltip
items.description: By default an avatar shows its name in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Pass a string to show custom text instead, or false to turn the tooltip off.

items.name: block-avatar-user-card
items.title: Avatar - User Card
items.description: Place an avatar next to a name and role to create a user card row. Use for comment headers, contact lists, profile sections, or anywhere you need to identify a person at a glance.

items.name: block-avatar-with-image
items.title: Avatar - Photo
items.description: Show a profile photo at different sizes. Use when you have a user photo URL. If the image fails to load, initials are shown instead.

items.name: block-avatar-with-status
items.title: Avatar - Status Dot
items.description: Add a status dot to an avatar to show whether someone is online, away, or busy. Use in chat, messaging, or any UI where knowing availability matters.

items.name: block-badge-category-tags
items.title: Badge - Colors
items.description: Tag items with color-coded categories like teams, priorities, or topics. Use the 9 non-semantic color variants when you need to distinguish groups visually.

items.name: block-badge-count-badges
items.title: Badge - Counts
items.description: Show a number inside a badge for notification counts, unread messages, or task totals. Use next to icons, nav items, or list labels.

items.name: block-badge-showcase
items.title: Badge - Variants
items.description: All semantic and color badge variants in a single view. Use semantic variants for status and color variants for categories.

items.name: block-badge-status-labels
items.title: Badge - Status
items.description: Show the state of an item like Active, Pending, or Failed. Use in table rows, list items, or detail pages where users need to see status at a glance.

items.name: block-banner-collapsible-content
items.title: Banner - Collapsible
items.description: Combine an action button, dismiss control, and a collapsible detail area in one banner. Children sit behind the toggle by default; `collapsible={{defaultIsOpen: true}}` starts it open, and `collapsible={false}` drops the toggle entirely. Use for complex notifications like config changes or deployment summaries.

items.name: block-banner-dismissable
items.title: Banner - Dismiss
items.description: Let the user close a banner after reading it. Use for maintenance notices, feature tips, or any non-critical message the user can acknowledge.

items.name: block-banner-floating
items.title: Banner - Floating
items.description: A floating banner raised with `elevation="med"`. Banners are inline by default; raise one when it should read as an overlay above content.

items.name: block-banner-section-variant
items.title: Banner - Full Width
items.description: A full-width banner with no border radius for page-level notifications. Use at the top of a page for site-wide announcements or maintenance alerts.

items.name: block-banner-showcase
items.title: Banner - Statuses
items.description: All four status banners stacked: info, success, warning, and error. A quick visual reference for choosing the right status.

items.name: block-banner-statuses
items.title: Banner - Statuses
items.description: All 4 banner statuses: info, success, warning, and error. Use to show persistent messages like updates, confirmations, cautions, or problems at the top of a page or section.

items.name: block-banner-with-action-button
items.title: Banner - Action
items.description: Add a button to a banner so the user can act on the message. Use for trial expirations, payment failures, or anything that needs a response.

items.name: block-base-typeahead-custom-search
items.title: BaseTypeahead - Custom Search Bar
items.description: BaseTypeahead embedded inside a custom-styled wrapper. The wrapper provides its own border and icon chrome; anchorRef positions the dropdown relative to it. Use this pattern when Typeahead's built-in field layout does not fit your composition.

items.name: block-base-typeahead-showcase
items.title: BaseTypeahead
items.description: A custom result renderer that adds supporting metadata while BaseTypeahead retains option semantics and keyboard behavior.

items.name: block-blockquote-showcase
items.title: Blockquote - Showcase
items.description: Blockquote with and without citation. A quick visual reference for the blockquote component.

items.name: block-blockquote-testimonials
items.title: Blockquote - Testimonials
items.description: Multiple quotes arranged in a card grid for a testimonials section. Combine with Card and Grid to create social-proof layouts.

items.name: block-blockquote-with-cite
items.title: Blockquote - With Attribution
items.description: A plain quote and a quote with a cite attribution. Use cite to credit the original author or source.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-heights
items.title: Bottom Sheet - Height variants
items.description: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-mobile-keyboard
items.title: Bottom Sheet - Mobile keyboard
items.description: Uses a tall, scrollable form that keeps focused controls visible above the mobile keyboard.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-no-scrim
items.title: Bottom Sheet - No scrim
items.description: Keeps the page visible and interactive behind a non-modal bottom sheet.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-showcase
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: A mobile filter surface that rises from the bottom edge.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-snap-points
items.title: Bottom Sheet - Snap points
items.description: Drag-to-resize stops: a half-height working surface, and a peek that slides away and thins the scrim.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-switcher-review-flow
items.title: Bottom Sheet Switcher - Review flow
items.description: A two-step form flow that lets a person review settings, confirm them, or move back without replacing the shared dialog.

items.name: block-bottom-sheet-switcher-showcase
items.title: Bottom Sheet Switcher
items.description: A three-step flow that transitions between content-hugging sheets of different heights inside one shared dialog.

items.name: block-breadcrumb-item-basic
items.title: BreadcrumbItem - Basic
items.description: Breadcrumb links inside a Breadcrumbs trail. Ancestor pages get an href; mark the last item with isCurrent to render it as plain text for the current page.

items.name: block-breadcrumb-item-showcase
items.title: BreadcrumbItem
items.description: BreadcrumbItem represents a single step in a breadcrumb trail, supporting links, icons, current-page markers, and custom link components.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs-custom-separator
items.title: Breadcrumbs - Separators
items.description: Swap the default "/" for a different character like chevrons, arrows, or dots. Use when the visual style of the page calls for a different separator.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs-deep-hierarchy
items.title: Breadcrumbs - Deep Path
items.description: A 5-level breadcrumb trail for deeply nested content. Use in e-commerce, file browsers, or any UI with several levels of hierarchy.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs-menu-item
items.title: Breadcrumbs - Menu item
items.description: Give a mid-trail crumb a `menu` prop to turn it into a menu trigger for switching between sibling destinations. It reuses the same item API as DropdownMenu, so an existing option array (or composed item children) drops in verbatim.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs-showcase
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: A breadcrumb trail showing page hierarchy with linked ancestors and a current page.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs-supporting-variant
items.title: Breadcrumbs - Variants
items.description: Compare the default and supporting variants side by side. Use the supporting variant in dense UIs like admin panels where the breadcrumb should be subtle.

items.name: block-breadcrumbs-with-icons
items.title: Breadcrumbs - Icons
items.description: Add icons before breadcrumb labels for quick recognition. Use a home icon on the root item and contextual icons on key sections.

items.name: block-button-floating
items.title: Button - Floating
items.description: A floating action button raised with `elevation="med"`. Use elevation for buttons that hover above content, like a FAB.

items.name: block-button-group-basic
items.title: ButtonGroup - Basic
items.description: Three related actions joined into a single connected control. Provide a group label for accessibility and keep all buttons the same variant so they read as one unit.

items.name: block-button-group-floating
items.title: ButtonGroup - Floating
items.description: A grouped action bar raised with `elevation="med"`. The connected buttons share one surface, so the shadow lifts them as a unit.

items.name: block-button-group-showcase
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: ButtonGroup block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-button-showcase
items.title: Button - Variants
items.description: All four button variants side by side: primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive. A quick visual reference for choosing the right variant.

items.name: block-button-size-variants
items.title: Button - Sizes
items.description: Small, medium, and large buttons side by side. Use small in dense UIs like toolbars, medium for most cases, and large for prominent CTAs.

items.name: block-button-variants
items.title: Button - Variants
items.description: All 4 button variants in default, disabled, and loading states. Use primary for the main action, secondary for most others, ghost for low-emphasis, and destructive for dangerous actions.

items.name: block-button-with-end-slot
items.title: Button - End Slot
items.description: Buttons with a trailing badge showing a count or status. Use for notification counts, unread messages, or any button that needs a visual indicator.

items.name: block-button-with-icon
items.title: Button - Icon
items.description: Buttons with a leading icon that reinforces the label. Use when the icon helps the user identify the action faster, like a plus for "New" or a trash can for "Delete".

items.name: block-calendar-constraints
items.title: Calendar - Constraints
items.description: Limit which dates can be selected using min/max bounds and custom rules like weekdays only. Use for scheduling UIs where certain dates are unavailable.

items.name: block-calendar-range-with-value
items.title: Calendar - Range
items.description: Pick a start and end date with the range highlighted between them. Use for booking dates, time-off requests, or report filters.

items.name: block-calendar-showcase
items.title: Calendar
items.description: An interactive single-date calendar with a selected date. Click any day to change the selection.

items.name: block-calendar-single
items.title: Calendar - Single
items.description: Pick one date from a month grid. Use for appointment dates, due dates, or any field that needs a single date.

items.name: block-calendar-two-months
items.title: Calendar - Two Months
items.description: Two months side by side for selecting ranges that span a month boundary. Use in booking or travel UIs where check-in and check-out often fall in different months.

items.name: block-card-callout
items.title: Card - Callout
items.description: Muted-variant cards for tips, notes, or supplementary information. Use when content should be visually distinct but not prominent. The muted variant uses a wash background instead of the elevated default, making it feel recessed rather than raised. Works well in sidebars, help panels, or inline callouts.

items.name: block-card-elevations
items.title: Card - Elevations
items.description: The four elevation levels side by side. Cards are flat by default; raise a card with `elevation` only when it needs to float above surrounding content.

items.name: block-card-showcase
items.title: Card
items.description: A card with a heading and body text showing the default container style.

items.name: block-card-variants
items.title: Card - Variants
items.description: Default, muted, and color variants side by side. Use color variants to categorize cards visually, like team colors, project tags, or content types. Each color uses the corresponding background token from the theme, so they adapt to light and dark mode automatically.

items.name: block-card-with-inner-layout
items.title: Card - Layout
items.description: A card with a structured header, content area, and footer with action buttons. Use for forms, dialogs, or settings panels that need clear sections. Pair Card with Layout to get automatic dividers between header, content, and footer. The footer aligns actions to the right by default.

items.name: block-card-with-simple-content
items.title: Card - Simple
items.description: A card with a heading and body text. Use for summaries, descriptions, or any grouped content that needs visual separation from the page. The card handles its own border, background, and padding; just pass your content as children. Set a width to constrain it, or leave it to fill the parent.

items.name: block-carousel-cards
items.title: Carousel - Cards
items.description: A horizontally scrollable row of cards with snap scrolling enabled. Use for feature grids, product lists, or any set of cards that overflows the available width. The carousel adds fade edges and navigation buttons automatically.

items.name: block-carousel-showcase
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A horizontal carousel of cards with scroll-snap and navigation buttons. Scroll or click the arrows to browse.

items.name: block-carousel-snap
items.title: Carousel - Snap
items.description: Scroll-snap carousel with navigation buttons and team member cards. Each card snaps to the start edge on scroll. Use when items should be viewed one at a time rather than as a continuous strip.

items.name: block-center-horizontal
items.title: Center - Horizontal Center
items.description: A formatting control group centered with axis="horizontal" in the default horizontal writing mode. In other writing modes, Center currently follows the flex main axis rather than guaranteeing physical horizontal centering.

items.name: block-center-inside-a-card
items.title: Center - Vertical & Horizontal Center
items.description: An empty state with an icon, heading, and description centered both vertically and horizontally inside a card. This is the most common use of Center: placing content in the middle of a fixed-height area like a panel, card, or content region. The height prop defines the centering space.

items.name: block-center-showcase
items.title: Center
items.description: Content centered horizontally and vertically inside a fixed-height container.

items.name: block-chat-composer-attachments
items.title: ChatComposer - Attachments
items.description: Chat composer with removable file tokens in a collapsible drawer. Use when users can attach files or context to their message.

items.name: block-chat-composer-drawer-attachments
items.title: ChatComposerDrawer - Attachments
items.description: Drawer with two rows: a scrollable carousel of image thumbnails and a row of removable file tokens. Omit count to keep the drawer always expanded.

items.name: block-chat-composer-drawer-collapsible
items.title: ChatComposerDrawer - Collapsible
items.description: Drawer with many items and a collapse toggle. Pass count to enable the toggle; collapsed state shows a badge with the total count and a label.

items.name: block-chat-composer-drawer-feedback
items.title: ChatComposerDrawer - Feedback
items.description: Chat composer drawer with a feedback prompt and selectable lettered options. Use for user confirmation workflows that require explicit action before proceeding.

items.name: block-chat-composer-drawer-showcase
items.title: ChatComposerDrawer
items.description: Composer drawer with file tokens, a collapsible toggle, and header actions. Use as a starting point for any chat composer with attachments.

items.name: block-chat-composer-drawer-with-progress
items.title: ChatComposerDrawer - With Progress
items.description: Drawer paired with a context progress bar in the header. Show context window usage when attachments consume part of the available token budget.

items.name: block-chat-composer-flat
items.title: ChatComposer - Flat
items.description: The composer is raised by default (`elevation="low"`). Set `elevation="none"` to flatten it; it then draws a border with the same rest / hover / focus treatment as a text input.

items.name: block-chat-composer-footer-actions
items.title: ChatComposer - Footer Actions
items.description: Chat composer with dropdown menus for a model selector and settings in the footer, and a mic button in the send actions slot.

items.name: block-chat-composer-full-featured
items.title: ChatComposer - Full Featured
items.description: Chat composer with all slots populated: collapsible attachment drawer, header actions, context progress bar, footer dropdown menus, and mic button. Shows the maximum composer configuration.

items.name: block-chat-composer-input-controlled-input
items.title: ChatComposerInput - Controlled
items.description: Controlled chat input with live value display. Use controlled mode when you need to read or transform the input value outside the composer.

items.name: block-chat-composer-input-disabled
items.title: ChatComposerInput - Disabled
items.description: Composer in a disabled state. Use when the input should be visible but not interactive, such as during streaming or when a prerequisite is unmet.

items.name: block-chat-composer-input-mention-trigger
items.title: ChatComposerInput - Mentions
items.description: Chat input with an @ trigger that opens a typeahead menu for mentioning users. Selected names appear as inline tokens.

items.name: block-chat-composer-input-multiple-triggers
items.title: ChatComposerInput - Multiple Triggers
items.description: Chat input with both @ mentions and / commands. Each trigger type renders tokens in a distinct color so users can tell them apart at a glance.

items.name: block-chat-composer-input-showcase
items.title: ChatComposerInput
items.description: ChatComposerInput block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-chat-composer-input-slash-commands

items.name: block-step-content
items.title: Step - Content Slot
items.description: Children passed to a Step render below its description, indented to line up with the label rather than the indicator, and stay outside the clickable label area so buttons inside remain their own targets. In a full flow you gate the slot on the step being active. That is what turns a vertical stepper into an expanding one.

items.name: block-step-indicator
items.title: Step - Indicator
items.description: Everything the indicator prop accepts: the auto default, an always-number badge, a custom ReactNode, and none, each on its own completed Step so the prop is the only difference between them. Every variant occupies the same 16px box, so a step swapping its number for a check as it completes never shifts the label beside it. The last cell shows that a custom node can be live rather than static: a Spinner on a step that is in progress, shaded `inherit` so it picks up the step's own tint like any other glyph.

items.name: block-step-showcase
items.title: Step
items.description: A single Step, with every part it can render: the indicator, the label with its optional marker and trailing endContent, and the description beneath. A Step never sets its own completed/current state. It declares its index and derives the rest from the parent Stepper, so one Step in one Stepper is a complete example.

items.name: block-step-states
items.title: Step - States
items.description: Every state a single Step can land in, each shown as one Step in its own Stepper. Completed, current, and upcoming are derived by comparing the step index against the parent activeStep, so they are never set directly; isDisabled and status are the two a step declares itself. Status is a separate axis from progress, which is why a completed step can still carry a warning.

items.name: block-stepper-custom-content
items.title: Stepper - Custom Content
items.description: A vertical stepper where each step owns a slice of the page. The content slot takes any node (form fields, a summary panel, a banner), so a stepper is not limited to multi-step forms. Rendering the slot only for the active step is what makes the flow expand one step at a time.

items.name: block-stepper-indicator-modes
items.title: Stepper - Indicator Modes
items.description: The indicator prop side by side: none (the bar and label carry the progress on their own), auto (check when done, ring when current, number ahead), always-number, and a custom icon per step.

items.name: block-stepper-on-track-horizontal

items.name: block-stepper-on-track-vertical

items.description: The on-track layout in vertical orientation: indicators sit inline on a continuous connector rail, with each label and description beside its node. Compare with the separated layout, where the indicator sits alongside its own bar segment instead of on a shared rail.

items.name: block-stepper-showcase
items.title: Stepper - Checkout Progress
items.description: The default stepper: a horizontal track where every step owns an equal segment of the progress bar above its label. The default auto indicator resolves itself per step: a check once the step is done, a ring on the current step, a number for the ones still ahead. Click any step to jump.

items.name: block-stepper-status

items.description: Semantic status per step in a verification flow: success shows a green check, error a red glyph, accent the in-progress step. Status sets the indicator color and glyph only, never the connector, and is announced to assistive tech as text.

items.name: block-theme-switcher

items.name: block-thumbnail-disabled

items.name: block-thumbnail-gallery

items.name: block-thumbnail-removable

items.name: block-time-input-constrained
items.title: TimeInput - Constrained

items.name: block-time-input-increment

items.name: block-time-input-states
items.title: TimeInput - States

items.name: block-timer-formats

items.name: block-timer-inline

items.name: block-timer-showcase

items.name: block-timestamp-auto-format
items.title: Timestamp - Auto
items.description: Auto format that shows relative time for recent dates and switches to the full date for older ones. The default choice for most use cases.

items.name: block-timestamp-colors
items.title: Timestamp - Colors
items.description: Timestamp rendered in each available color variant: primary, secondary, disabled, and active.

items.name: block-timestamp-formats
items.title: Timestamp - Formats
items.description: All display formats side by side: date, date_time, time, and their system equivalents. Use date and date_time for user-facing UI, system variants for logs and dev tools.

items.name: block-timestamp-relative-format
items.title: Timestamp - Relative

items.name: block-timestamp-showcase
items.title: Timestamp
items.description: Timestamp block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-timestamp-timezone
items.title: Timestamp - Timezone
items.description: Timestamps with the timezone abbreviation appended. Enable isTimezoneShown for audiences across time zones, like audit logs or team calendars.

items.name: block-timestamp-tooltip-timezones
items.title: Timestamp - Tooltip time zones
items.description: Hover tooltips that show one instant across several time zones or formats. Use tooltipEntries when readers must compare zones, like an incident log carrying both the reader's time and the event's origin zone.

items.name: block-toast-action
items.title: Toast - Action
items.description: Persistent toasts with a trailing button or link so the user can act on the notification, like undoing a delete or viewing a report.

items.name: block-toast-deduplication
items.title: Toast - Deduplication
items.description: Prevent duplicate toasts with uniqueID. Use ignore to keep the first toast, or overwrite to replace it with updated content like a progress percentage.

items.name: block-toast-dismiss
items.title: Toast - Dismiss
items.description: Show a persistent toast and dismiss it programmatically using the function returned by useToast. Use for long-running operations that need manual cleanup.

items.name: block-toast-showcase
items.title: Toast
items.description: Imperative toast notifications triggered with useToast and rendered in the toast viewport.

items.name: block-toast-stacking
items.title: Toast - Stacking
items.description: Multiple toasts stacking vertically with smooth enter and exit animations. Click repeatedly to see how toasts queue and dismiss.

items.name: block-toast-types
items.title: Toast - Types
items.description: Info and error toast variants side by side. Info toasts auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, error toasts persist until the user dismisses them.

items.name: block-toggle-button-color
items.title: ToggleButton - Color
items.description: Toggle buttons with colored icons in the pressed state. Shows accent-colored toolbar formatting and semantic reaction colors (yellow star, red heart, blue bookmark).

items.name: block-toggle-button-group
items.title: ToggleButton - Group

items.name: block-toggle-button-group-showcase
items.title: ToggleButtonGroup
items.description: ToggleButtonGroup manages a set of ToggleButtons with single-select or multi-select behavior for options like view modes or filters.

items.name: block-toggle-button-group-vertical
items.title: ToggleButtonGroup - Vertical
items.description: A vertically stacked ToggleButtonGroup using the vertical orientation, shown with both single-select and multi-select behavior, ideal for sidebar-style option lists and vertical toolbars.

items.name: block-toggle-button-icon-swap
items.title: ToggleButton - Icon Swap
items.description: Icon-only toggle buttons that swap between outline and solid icons when pressed. Use for actions like favorite, bookmark, or mute where the icon itself communicates the state.

items.name: block-toggle-button-label
items.title: ToggleButton - Label
items.description: Toggle buttons with visible text labels that show a font weight shift on press. Use when the icon alone is not enough to communicate the action.

items.name: block-toggle-button-showcase
items.title: ToggleButton
items.description: ToggleButton block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-toggle-button-states
items.title: ToggleButton - States
items.description: Default, pressed, disabled, and loading states of a standalone toggle button. Shows how visual treatment changes across states.

items.name: block-token-clickable
items.title: Token - Clickable
items.description: Interactive tokens that respond to clicks. Use for toggleable filters or tokens that open a detail view when selected.

items.name: block-token-colors
items.title: Token - Colors
items.description: All 11 color variants in default and disabled states. Use color to categorize entities or convey status at a glance.

items.name: block-token-end-content
items.title: Token - End Content
items.description: Tokens with trailing content like a count badge or status indicator after the label. Use for notification counts, item quantities, or compact status info.

items.name: block-token-icon
items.title: Token - Icon
items.description: Tokens with a leading icon that identifies the entity type. Use when the icon helps users recognize the token category faster, like a user icon for people or a tag icon for labels.

items.name: block-token-removable
items.title: Token - Removable
items.description: Tokens with a dismiss button for selections the user can undo. Use in multi-select fields, active filters, or any list of user-chosen items.

items.name: block-token-showcase
items.title: Token
items.description: Token block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-tokenizer-clear
items.title: Tokenizer - Clear
items.description: Tokenizer with a built-in clear-all button for bulk removal of all selected tokens.

items.name: block-tokenizer-creatable
items.title: Tokenizer - Creatable
items.description: Free-text tokenizer for creating custom tags and a combined create-or-search pattern. Use when users need to enter values that may not exist in a predefined list.

items.name: block-tokenizer-end-content
items.title: Tokenizer - End Content
items.description: Tokenizer with an action button in the end slot. Use for inline actions like applying selections alongside the input.

items.name: block-tokenizer-icon
items.title: Tokenizer - Icon
items.description: Tokenizer with a leading search icon to visually reinforce the search behavior.

items.name: block-tokenizer-max-entries
items.title: Tokenizer - Max Entries
items.description: Tokenizer with a maximum selection limit. The input hides automatically when the limit is reached, preventing further additions.

items.name: block-tokenizer-overflow
items.title: Tokenizer - Overflow
items.description: Tokenizer with overflow truncation when unfocused. Inline mode pushes content down on expand; layer mode overlays without shifting layout.

items.name: block-tokenizer-showcase
items.title: Tokenizer
items.description: A tokenizer with preset tags and search source.

items.name: block-tokenizer-states
items.title: Tokenizer - States
items.description: Tokenizer in disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use to communicate validation feedback or lock a selection from editing.

items.name: block-toolbar-bulk-actions
items.title: Toolbar - Bulk Actions
items.description: A compact toolbar with the muted variant for showing bulk selection actions. Use when the user selects multiple items in a list or table and needs quick access to batch operations.

items.name: block-toolbar-card-header
items.title: Toolbar - Card Header
items.description: A toolbar as a card header with a left-aligned title and icon actions on the right. Use Toolbar instead of LayoutHeader when your card header has interactive actions; Toolbar adds start/end slot layout, keyboard navigation, and automatic size cascading. If the header is just a title with no actions, a LayoutHeader or Section is enough.

items.name: block-toolbar-sizes
items.title: Toolbar - Sizes
items.description: Small, medium, and large toolbars side by side. The size prop cascades to child buttons and inputs automatically. Use small in dense UIs like cards, medium for most cases, and large for spacious layouts.

items.name: block-toolbar-table-filter
items.title: Toolbar - Table Filter
items.description: Filter bar above a table: a search box leads the row, each field beside it is a closed trigger that doubles as its own filter chip — the bare field name unset, the whole clause once set — and the clauses fold from the end into a count as the row narrows, followed by a live result count, a clear all, and a column picker. Use to search, filter, and narrow flat rows of records such as jobs, orders, tickets, or users.

items.name: block-toolbar-three-slot
items.title: Toolbar - Three Slot
items.description: A toolbar with start, center, and end content using the three-column grid layout. Use when you need a centered title or heading with navigation and actions on either side.

items.name: block-toolbar-with-tabs
items.title: Toolbar - Tab Navigation
items.description: A toolbar with tabs in the start slot and an action button at the end. Use as a card or section header when content is split into tabs with a primary action alongside.

items.name: block-tooltip-action-bar-tooltips

items.description: Tooltips on an action button bar with contextual descriptions.

items.title: TopNavItem

items.name: block-top-nav-mega-menu
items.title: TopNav - Mega Menu
items.description: Marketing-style navigation with a full-width mega menu featuring product items and a promotional featured card.

items.name: block-top-nav-mega-menu-basic
items.title: TopNavMegaMenu - Basic
items.description: A mega menu trigger inside a TopNav that opens a panel of rich link items. Use when a navigation section has multiple destinations worth describing.

items.name: block-top-nav-mega-menu-featured-card-basic

items.description: A promotional card with a title, description, and call-to-action link. Pass it to the featured slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to highlight announcements.

items.name: block-top-nav-mega-menu-item-basic
items.title: TopNavMegaMenuItem - Basic

items.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuItem with icons, titles, and descriptions inside a mega menu.

items.title: TopNavMegaMenu
items.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenu with items and a featured card in the mega menu panel.

items.name: block-top-nav-menu-basic
items.title: TopNavMenu - Basic
items.description: A dropdown menu inside a TopNav built from an items array with icons and descriptions. Use to group related destinations under a single trigger.

items.name: block-top-nav-menu-showcase
items.title: TopNavMenu
