items.name: block-top-nav-with-logo
items.title: TopNav - With Logo
items.description: Navigation bar with a branded logo icon, heading link, nav items, and a profile action.

items.name: block-tree-list-file-tree-with-icons
items.title: TreeList - File Tree With Icons
items.description: File browser tree with folder and document icons distinguishing directories from files.

items.name: block-tree-list-interactive-settings
items.title: TreeList - Interactive Settings
items.description: Settings tree with clickable items and a documentation link.

items.title: TreeList - Mailbox Tree
items.description: Email folder tree with unread badge counts.

items.title: TreeList - Navigation Tree
items.description: Navigation tree with a selected item for the current page.

items.title: TreeList
items.description: TreeList block built with XO UI.

items.description: The `variant` prop controls whether hierarchy guide lines are shown: `lineGuides` (default) draws connector lines between parent and child rows, while `noGuides` relies on indentation alone. It is orthogonal to `density`, which controls spacing.

items.name: block-typeahead-item-basic
items.title: TypeaheadItem - Basic
items.description: A typeahead whose results are rendered with TypeaheadItem, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderItem to keep custom results visually consistent.

items.name: block-typeahead-item-showcase
items.title: TypeaheadItem
items.description: Typeahead with custom item rendering using TypeaheadItem for avatars and descriptions.

items.name: block-typeahead-limited-results
items.title: Typeahead - Limited Results
items.description: Typeahead with a capped dropdown showing at most three results.

items.name: block-typeahead-search-field
items.title: Typeahead - Search Field
items.description: Search input with icon and suggestions on focus.

items.description: Typeahead block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-typeahead-with-helper-text

items.description: Typeahead with a description below the label.

items.name: block-typeahead-with-validation
items.title: Typeahead - With Validation
items.description: Typeahead with an error validation message.

items.name: block-use-container-reveal-hook-usage
items.title: useContainerReveal - Reveal-on-hover Row Actions
items.description: File rows keep their edit/delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.

items.name: block-use-keyboard-hint-hook-usage
items.title: useKeyboardHint - Arrow-key Hint
items.description: Toolbar shows an ephemeral "← → to navigate" hint on first keyboard focus via useKeyboardHint, teaching sighted keyboard users that arrows move within the group.

items.name: block-use-streaming-text-hook-usage
items.title: useStreamingText - Streaming Response
items.description: Smooth bursty generated text into a steady reveal with useStreamingText.

items.name: block-use-theme-hook-usage
items.title: useTheme - Token Values
items.description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

items.name: block-v-stack-basic
items.title: VStack - Basic
items.description: A heading and paragraphs stacked vertically with a consistent gap. Use VStack whenever siblings should flow top to bottom with even spacing.

items.name: block-v-stack-showcase
items.title: VStack
items.description: Demonstrates VStack arranging items vertically with different gaps.

items.name: block-visually-hidden-live-region
items.title: VisuallyHidden - Live Region
items.description: A polite aria-live region announces visual-only state changes to assistive technology.

items.name: block-visually-hidden-showcase
items.title: VisuallyHidden
items.description: VisuallyHidden block built with XO UI.

items.name: block-visually-hidden-structural-heading
items.title: VisuallyHidden - Structural Heading
items.description: Give a visually implicit section an accessible name so screen-reader users can navigate to it.

items.name: block-visually-hidden-supplementary-context
items.title: VisuallyHidden - Supplementary Context
items.description: Add screen-reader-only context to terse visual data, like spelling out what a trend arrow means.

items.name: template-ai-chat
items.title: AI Chat Conversation
items.description: Transcript of alternating turns carrying mixed rich content inline (markdown, code blocks, collapsible tool-call output) beside a resizable artifact panel that holds generated output while the stream keeps scrolling. Chat, conversation, assistant, messages, or copilot thread.

items.name: template-ai-chat-landing
items.title: AI Chat Landing
items.description: Zero-state entry surface centered on a single composer with suggestion chips instead of history, sized for the moment before any content exists. The empty counterpart to a transcript. Chat, conversation, assistant, prompt, or messages launcher.

items.name: template-blank
items.title: Blank
items.description: Bare scaffold: one heading slot, one empty content region, no navigation and no chrome. The starting point when every other layout imposes more structure than wanted. Blank, empty, stub, placeholder, or minimal scaffold.

items.name: template-canvas-editor
items.title: Canvas Editor
items.description: Layered artboard workspace: document tabs over a layer rail, a fixed-size frame you zoom on a muted backdrop, and an inspector of position, type, and filter fields that retargets to the selected layer. Objects hold a coordinate rather than reflowing, so moving one never moves another. Design tool, artboard, poster, graphic, image, or slide editor.

items.name: template-centered-hero
items.title: Centered Hero
items.description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing. Hero, banner, splash, landing image, or marketing masthead.

items.name: template-checkout-wizard
items.title: Checkout Wizard
items.description: Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change. It adapts to its host width, renders the summary first on narrow surfaces, validates every forward path, and completes locally without sending payment.

items.name: template-classic-gallery
items.title: Classic Gallery
items.description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place. Regular rhythm, unlike the variable-height masonry variant. Gallery, photos, images, pictures, or portfolio index.

items.name: template-contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit. No steps, no branching, no summary rail. Contact, lead capture, enquiry, survey, or intake form.

items.name: template-dashboard
items.title: Analytics Dashboard
items.description: Three-band analytics: a row of headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all re-reading from one global filter bar. Breadth over depth, a summary surface rather than a drill-down. Dashboard, overview, metrics, stats, analytics, reporting, or insights.

items.name: template-dashboard-alert-rail
items.title: Service Monitoring Dashboard
items.description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow. Monitoring, uptime, health, latency, alerting, incidents, or observability.

items.name: template-dashboard-cohort-funnel
items.title: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
items.description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap. Conversion, drop-off, activation, churn, or retention reporting.

items.name: template-dashboard-comparison
items.title: Data Dashboard
items.description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath. Every number is shown against another number. Dashboard, metrics, stats, analytics, trends, or reporting.

items.name: template-dashboard-composition
items.title: Portfolio Dashboard
items.description: Analytics for a value-over-time question: balance and change tiles above a stacked area chart of composition through time, closing on a ranked table of the largest contributors. Portfolio, holdings, positions, returns, allocation, investments, or performance reporting.

items.name: template-dashboard-progress
items.title: Project Status Dashboard
items.description: Status analytics mixing progress and time-axis shapes: a completion donut, a horizontal timeline of dated bars against a today marker, a per-owner table with progress and status, an at-risk list, and a burndown. Project, program, milestone, roadmap, launch, or delivery status.

items.name: template-dashboard-scorecard
items.title: Executive Summary Dashboard
items.description: Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow. Executive summary, business review, readout, or reporting.

items.name: template-detail-page
items.title: Order Detail
items.description: Single-record detail in two columns: a summary header with status and actions, a repeating line-item list, a totals block that sums it, and a chronological activity timeline in the rail. The shape for any record holding children plus a history: a customer order with shipping, an invoice, a transaction, or a job.

items.name: template-documentation
items.title: Documentation Catalog
items.description: Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself. Documentation, docs, guide, handbook, reference, or API index.

items.name: template-documentation-design
items.title: Documentation Design
items.description: Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks. Documentation, docs, guide, reference, usage, or API entry.

items.name: template-documentation-technical
items.title: Documentation Technical
items.description: Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links. A linear walkthrough rather than a browsable reference. Getting started, install, setup, tutorial, quickstart, or onboarding guide.

items.name: template-editor
items.title: Page Editor
items.description: Three-pane authoring workspace: a source palette on one flank, a live canvas in the middle, and an inspector that retargets to whatever is selected. Drag and drop to reorder, edit to see it render immediately. Builder, composer, drag and drop, page builder, or WYSIWYG editor.

items.name: template-file-explorer
items.title: File Explorer
items.description: Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node. Files, folders, directory, tree, or Finder-style navigator.

items.name: template-form-two-column
items.title: Two-column Form
items.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll. Flat, single submit, no steps. Contact, lead capture, intake, request, or enquiry form.

items.name: template-form-wizard
items.title: Form Wizard
items.description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields. Only the current step renders, unlike an accordion where each section expands into one long scrolling form. Each advance is validated, and a step left broken stays flagged to jump back to. Wizard, stepper, multi-step, onboarding, setup, signup, or guided flow.

items.name: template-form-wizard-dialog
items.title: Dialog Wizard
items.description: Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was. Compact step markers and a pinned action row inside a constrained width, rather than the full page a wizard usually gets. Best for two to four short steps — setup, invite, schedule, onboarding — where losing the context underneath would cost more than the flow is worth.

items.name: template-form-wizard-inline
items.title: Inline Wizard
items.description: Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in. Steps that run themselves expand into a nested stepper that ticks check by check and halts the column where one fails. Best when later steps depend on what earlier ones decided.

items.name: template-form-wizard-vertical
items.title: Vertical Wizard
items.description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field. Suits long or unequal steps carrying uploads, previews, and dense review metadata. As width tightens the guidance drops first, then the rail rotates into a horizontal stepper above the form.

items.name: template-gallery-hero
items.title: Gallery Hero
items.description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set. Hero, banner, splash, landing image, masthead, or gallery intro.

items.name: template-ide
items.title: IDE
items.description: Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite. Drag a divider to resize or collapse any of them. Editor, IDE, workbench, terminal, or development environment.

items.name: template-incident-console
items.title: Incident Console
items.description: Dense row queue with an inspector: severity-coded rows grouped by status, a saved-search filter bar, a segmented status control, and a resizable detail pane for the selected row. Rows, not cards, sized for scanning volume. Incident, alert, on-call, outage, ticket, or triage console.

items.name: template-kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change. Fixed columns, variable-height cards. Kanban, board, swimlane, sprint, backlog, tasks, or pipeline.

items.name: template-library
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them. Catalog, index, directory, library, browse, or gallery of entries.

items.name: template-login
items.title: Basic Login
items.description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention. The least-chrome entry surface. Login, sign in, signin, authentication, credentials, or account access.

items.name: template-login-card
items.title: Login Card
items.description: Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath. Login, sign in, signin, authentication, credentials, social, or account access.

items.name: template-login-split
items.title: Login Split
items.description: Credential form filling one half of a two-pane split, full-bleed media holding the other. Same fields as the card variant, but the layout carries brand imagery. Login, sign in, signin, authentication, credentials, or account access.

items.name: template-login-sso
items.title: Login SSO
items.description: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback. Two-stage rather than one form. Single sign-on, SSO, SAML, enterprise login, directory, or corporate authentication.

items.name: template-messaging-shell
items.title: Messaging Shell
items.description: Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next. Dense rows, zero cards. Team messaging, chat, channels, threads, inbox, direct message, or conversation workspace.

items.name: template-mixed-gallery
items.title: Mixed Gallery
items.description: Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile. Irregular rhythm, unlike the uniform gallery. Photos, images, pictures, portfolio, masonry, or media wall.

items.name: template-payment-form
items.title: Checkout Form
items.description: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then card details. Checkout, payment, billing, cart, buyer, or purchase.

items.name: template-product-detail
items.title: Product Detail
items.description: Single-item detail pairing a media gallery with a selection column: variant swatches, a quantity stepper, primary and secondary commit actions, and collapsible specification sections below. Product, listing, item, catalog entry, or storefront detail.

items.name: template-product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.description: Uniform card grid where every tile carries media, title, supporting line, and a price. Browse-to-select only, with no filtering and no detail surface. Products, catalog, storefront, shop, listings, or ecommerce grid.

items.name: template-settings
items.title: Settings Form
items.description: Preferences as one continuously scrolling form, sections stacked in order with no navigation between them. The simplest settings shape: everything reachable by scrolling. Settings, preferences, configuration, options, or account.

items.name: template-settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.description: Preferences inside a modal container with searchable section navigation, so configuration happens without leaving whatever is underneath. Grouped toggles, live preview of appearance choices, rebindable shortcuts. Settings, preferences, configuration, options, or modal dialog.

items.name: template-settings-sidebar
items.title: Settings Panels
items.description: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form. Settings, preferences, configuration, options, or account panels.

items.name: template-shell-nav
items.title: Shell Nav
items.description: Application frame combining both navigation axes: a top menu bar with command-palette search over a resizable hierarchy rail, wrapping placeholder content. For when one axis is not enough. Shell, chrome, layout frame, navigation, sidebar, or menu bar.

items.name: template-shell-side-nav
items.title: Side Nav
items.description: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content. Vertical navigation only, no top bar. Shell, chrome, layout frame, sidebar, drawer, left rail, or navigation.

items.name: template-shell-top-nav
items.title: Top Nav
items.description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width. Shell, chrome, layout frame, header, menu, topbar, or navigation.

items.name: template-side-gallery
items.title: Side Gallery
items.description: Asymmetric split section: a copy column of headline, supporting text, and links held against a clustered image collage opposite. Deliberately off-balance, unlike the centered hero. Feature banner, split section, marketing, or gallery intro.

items.name: template-table
items.title: Simple Table
items.description: Flat row collection where columns sort, rows select into a bulk-action toolbar, and each row carries an overflow menu. Sortable but ungrouped, with no detail pane, the baseline shape. Table, list, rows, records, grid, spreadsheet, or roster.

items.name: template-table-filter
items.title: Filterable Table
items.description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane. Table, list, rows, records, grid, search, or filtered dataset.

items.name: template-table-grouped
items.title: Grouped Table
items.description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row. Table, list, rows, records, grid, or grouped dataset.

items.name: template-table-inbox
items.title: Inbox Table
items.description: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize. Rows stack when the table narrows, not the window; threads read as collapsible messages; replying opens a composer that leaves the list live. Inbox, mail, email, conversations, thread, triage, reading pane, split pane, resize, collapse, compose, or notifications.

items.name: template-table-page
items.title: Searchable Table
items.description: Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once — a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers — with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail, and totals derived from the visible rows that flag themselves as partial while a filter is on. The shape for one homogeneous list, not nested rows or groups with their own columns. Search, filter, sort, table, data table, flat rows, records, dataset, or totals.

items.name: template-table-tree
items.title: Tree Table
items.description: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children — a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README. Columns resize, siblings sort within their own level, arrow keys walk the rows, and search prunes the tree to matching branches. Tree, hierarchy, nested rows, drilldown, expand, collapse, resizable, expandable, file browser, repository, rolled-up parents.

items.name: template-theme-showcase
items.title: Theme Showcase
items.description: Several unrelated product surfaces rendered together on one canvas so a token change can be judged across contexts at once. A comparison harness rather than a layout to ship. Theme, tokens, palette, typography, styling, or design system preview.

items.name: template-work-item-detail
items.title: Work Item Detail
items.description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items. The shape for any tracked item with children, properties, and a comment history — a task, ticket, issue, story, bug, card, request, or work item.
